subject: EoY temporary throughput uplift & settlement (BrightGrid)
messages:
From: Sara Khoury <sara@brightgrid.com>
To: Michael Grant <michael_grant@redwood.com>
Cc: BrightGrid Procurement <procurement@brightgrid.com>
Date: 2026-12-30T16:02:00Z
Subject: Quick: temporary headroom for NYE launch

Hi Michael,

We're deploying a critical update for our consumer feature this weekend and expect a 6-8 hour spike around midnight ET. Our current quota will fall short and we'd like to request a short-term uplift (roughly +250% concurrency and a soft increase in token throughput) from 2026-12-31 22:00 ET to 2027-01-01 04:00 ET.

We need two things:
- An estimate of the incremental cost (either per-hour or flat uplift fee) and how you plan to bill it (pro-rata vs one-off).
- Confirmation that there will be no throttling/failures if we push this through.

If possible, can we get a written short-term amendment or PO path today? Procurement is on standby.

Thanks —
Sara
Sara Khoury
Head of Infrastructure, BrightGrid
+sara@brightgrid.com

[Attachment: launch_runbook_v3.pdf (pdf)]

From: Michael Grant <michael_grant@redwood.com>
To: Sara Khoury <sara@brightgrid.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-12-30T17:05:00Z
Subject: Re: Quick: temporary headroom for NYE launch

Hi Sara —

Thanks for the heads-up and congrats on the release. We can absolutely support a short window uplift. High-level options (quick summary):

1) Emergency headroom (hourly metered uplift): +250% concurrency, charged at 2.5x your committed rate for the uplift window, invoiced as a one-off on next invoice. No contract change required; temporary routing and capacity reserved.

2) Blended temporary uplift (discounted fixed uplift): flat supplemental fee that covers the entire window, priced at an estimated 1.8x blended effective rate if you submit a PO today. This requires a short amendment to add the uplift window to the order.

3) Safety-net credit (for unexpected overrun): we can enable an automatic fallback to a lower-cost model if utilization exceeds the uplift, and cap the total charge at a pre-agreed amount — useful if you want cost predictability but are still uncertain about exact traffic.

Operational guarantees: we'll route traffic to dedicated burst capacity and set throttling thresholds only if capacity constraints are severe; we'll send live traces to your SRE channel and set a 15-minute escalation path.

Next steps I recommend: if Procurement can issue a PO now, option 2 is fastest (we'll attach an amendment and a short invoice). If procurement needs approval, choose option 1 and we'll bill post-facto.

Looping Ben for pricing final sign-off and Lauren for a minimal amendment.

— Michael
Michael Grant
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
michael_grant@redwood.com
+1 415 555 0172

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Michael Grant <michael_grant@redwood.com>, Sara Khoury <sara@brightgrid.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-12-30T18:12:00Z
Subject: Re: Quick: temporary headroom for NYE launch

Sara — thanks for the clarity. Two quick clarifications from pricing:

- We can offer option 2 at a capped uplift fee of $18,500 for the 6-hour window (this assumes your observed token distribution and prompt sizes from last month's traffic). If the actual usage is materially lower we'll credit the difference on the next invoice.
- If you prefer per-hour metering (option 1) the expected range is $2,800–$4,200 per hour depending on peak token/sec; we'll provide an hour-by-hour estimate after you confirm the likely concurrency profile.

If Procurement can confirm a PO for $18,500 and attach the PO to the amendment, we will:
1) Build the capacity reservation for the requested window.
2) Prepare a one-page amendment to cover the uplift window and invoicing (Lauren is drafting).
3) Deliver an interim invoice today so your AP team can process payment before the window.

If you want, I can draft a short email Procurement can use to issue the PO — we've found that speeds things up.

— Ben
Ben Carter
Head of Strategic Accounts, Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.com

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
To: Sara Khoury <sara@brightgrid.com>, Michael Grant <michael_grant@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, BrightGrid Procurement <procurement@brightgrid.com>
Date: 2026-12-31T11:45:00Z
Subject: Re: Quick: temporary headroom for NYE launch — amendment + invoice

Hi all —

Attached is a minimal amendment (EoY_amendment_BG-4491_v2.docx) that adds the uplift window and the fixed uplift fee to the current SOW. Key points:
- Amendment is scoped to 2026-12-31 22:00 ET — 2027-01-01 04:00 ET.
- Fixed uplift fee: $18,500 (one-time).
- No change to data handling, retention, or model guarantees; standard SLA applies.
- Invoice attached: Redwood_temp_uplift_invoice_20261231.pdf — if Procurement can process the PO and reference invoice #RG-BG-4491, AP will reconcile against the invoice and we will enable the reservation once payment is acknowledged.

Sara — if you confirm PO issuance and attach BrightGrid_PO_4491.pdf in reply, I'll countersign the amendment and kick off capacity reservations. If Procurement prefers DocuSign, here's our envelope link: https://docusign.example.com/Envelope/ABCD1234

Quick legal note: this amendment is intentionally timeboxed and non-precedential. Please confirm and we will sign today.

Thanks —
Lauren Bishop
Legal & Contracts, Redwood Inference
lauren_bishop@redwood.com
